# vector diff

Prove two programs equivalent, or show where they differ.

## Usage

```text
vector diff <old.json> <new.json> [flags]
```

## Arguments

<scalar-field name="&lt;old.json&gt;" required>

the program before

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="&lt;new.json&gt;" required>

the program after

</scalar-field>

## Flags

<scalar-field name="--json">

print the result as JSON

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="-h, --help">

Show this command's help, and exit 0.

</scalar-field>
